I am writing to express my keen interest in the Content & Campaign Marketing Specialist position in Herentals, Belgium, as advertised. My background as a digital marketer, specializing in SEO, content creation, and web optimization, aligns strongly with your requirements.

In my previous roles, I've consistently driven organic growth through keyword-targeted content, technical SEO audits, and comprehensive website management. My CV provides further details. Thank you for your time and consideration.

cover_letter:
Dear Kemin Talent Acquisition Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Content & Campaign Marketing Specialist position in Herentals, Belgium, which I discovered through your posting. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, coupled with a technical acumen in web and SEO, I am confident that my skills and experience align perfectly with Kemin’s vision for creating engaging content and impactful campaigns across EMENA.

My professional journey has focused on transforming ideas into measurable digital presence and engagement. In my roles as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto and Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts, I have consistently delivered results through on-page SEO, keyword research, and the creation of targeted blog and website content. My expertise extends to technical SEO audits, implementing structured data, and optimizing websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, as demonstrated with mirook.com, where I measurably raised its search-health score. I am adept at translating complex topics into clear, compelling narratives across various digital channels, ensuring a consistent brand voice.

Beyond content creation, I possess hands-on experience in managing the digital elements of campaigns, leveraging tools like Google Analytics, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and optimize strategies. My Google Ads Search Certification and HubSpot Academy Content Marketing Certification underscore my commitment to both driving traffic and managing lead-nurturing programs effectively. I regularly integrate AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT into my workflow for research and content generation, enhancing efficiency and innovation—a skill I understand Kemin values. Furthermore, my proficiency with Canva allows me to contribute simple, on-brand visual assets.

My proactive approach, combined with meticulous planning and the ability to manage multiple projects, enables me to contribute effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative international team. Based in Belgium and fluent in English, with conversational Dutch, I am well-prepared to integrate seamlessly into your EMENA marketing team. I am particularly drawn to Kemin’s dedication to applied science and improving quality of life, resonating with my desire to contribute to meaningful work.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how my unique blend of marketing and technical skills can benefit Kemin.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
Zwijndrecht, Belgium
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cv_highlights:
Experience in content creation and copywriting, including SEO blog writing, website content management, and optimizing client sites for organic traffic, using WordPress, Elementor, and Rank Math.
Hands-on knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, SEA (Google Ads certified), and analytics, with expertise in tracking results using Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs.
HubSpot Academy Content Marketing Certified, with daily practical use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for research, content generation, and audit efficiency.
Proven technical SEO expertise, including keyword research, structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and running iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised search-health scores.
Based in Belgium, fluent in English, with additional proficiency in Dutch (B1/A2+), offering a strong fit for an EMENA marketing team.
